contradictions.why: The Safety tab's AVALANCHE section flatly reads N/A for every month it lists, but the same tab's KNOWN HAZARDS entry and the Reports tab's climate fields both describe real avalanche potential for early-season/spring attempts on the same Katwalk approach and summit gullies -- a climber reading only the AVALANCHE panel would conclude there is no avalanche concern at all.
contradictions.internal_resolution: hazards, climate.spring, and climate.bySeason.spring all agree there is real early-season avalanche exposure; seasonal_hazards.avalanche's blanket N/A (scoped only to the Jul-Oct window) contradicts what the rest of the row says about shoulder-season attempts.
